blocks.text: A duelist's weapon — win fights one opponent at a time through precise single-target bursts and timed defense. Precision here is **timing**, not luck: no crits, no armor-piercing — just reading the fight and hitting the beat.

text: *The Sword is the trace left by **The One Who Answered** — the Unwritten who met every challenge alone, one at a time, and never lost the exchange. Every skill below is a fragment of how they fought.*

blocks.text: **Status:** the Sword's pool is complete — every skill below is built and in the game except **Pressure**, which is finished but not yet switched on for drops. Numbers are still in tuning.
Every Sword rolls its kit from this pool: **1 ultimate + a few actives + a few passives**.

blocks.subtitle: One per Sword. 40 MP, and a long cooldown rather than a charge meter.

skills.name: Deathblow
skills.effect: One massive blow for **600% Attack**, **+40% for every Momentum stack** you hold, then spends them all. Without Momentum it is still a flat **600% Attack** — it just doesn't scale.

skills.name: Retribution
skills.effect: Cashes the damage **Brace** is holding. Strikes for **100% Attack plus 250% of the banked total**, split across **5 hits**, and **erases the debt** — you never pay what you release. Needs something banked to be worth casting.

skills.name: Blade Dance
skills.effect: Arms two sets of charges for **8s**, both sized by how fast you swing: **one dance charge per swing you'd fit into 8 seconds**, and **half that many Parry charges**. Then it beats **3 times per swing** — each beat spends a dance charge, flashes you to the next point of a **seven-pointed star**, leaves a **1s afterimage**, and strikes for **100% Attack**. Every beat re-aims at a living target within **3 units** of the last one, so the dance walks from foe to foe. Each dance charge you still hold is **+1% damage**, so the storm is fiercest at its opening. The Parry charges are your only guard — when they run out, you are exposed.

skills.name: Lunge
skills.effect: Dashes to the target and strikes for **100% Attack**. With **Lock Blades**, casting it also arms **5 charges**.

skills.name: Parry
skills.effect: Fully negates the next incoming hit within **3s** (**0 damage**) and is spent by it.

skills.name: Brace
skills.flavor: Take it now, pay it later.
skills.effect: Arms **5 charges** for **4s**. Each charge holds back one incoming hit — that damage is **banked** instead of costing you health. When the window ends, everything banked lands at once. A delay, not a save: **Retribution** is the only way out of the bill, and the cooldown is longer than the window so you can't postpone it forever.

skills.name: Guard Stance
skills.effect: Reduces damage taken by **50%** for **6s**.

skills.name: Overclock
skills.effect: Grants **+30% Attack Speed** for **8s** and makes you take **double damage** for the first **3s**. Blade Dance turns the speed into more charges, more parries and a faster storm; Retribution banks the doubled damage; Deathblow builds Momentum quicker.

skills.name: Onslaught
skills.effect: Arms **5 stacks of +1% damage** for **5s** (up to **7**), then spends them: **2 beats per swing**, each beat burning one stack to land a **real basic attack**. Real ones, so every beat feeds Momentum and fires every on-basic-attack passive.

skills.name: Committed Strike
skills.effect: Winds up for **1.2s**, then lands a single heavy hit for **200% Attack** — the Sword's strongest non-ultimate strike.

skills.name: Disarm
skills.effect: A strike for **100% Attack** that leaves them holding a charge: their **next attack lands 40% weaker**, within **6s**. It weakens — it never stuns or denies.

skills.name: Offbeat
skills.effect: A strike for **100% Attack** that cuts the target's **Attack Speed by 30%** for **5s**. Fewer swings coming at you means every Parry and Brace window covers more of the fight. Nothing is denied — only made rarer.

skills.name: Challenge
skills.effect: Taunts one enemy for **5s**: it is locked onto you, **cannot use skills**, and takes **no pause between swings**. It deals no damage — the lock is the whole skill. A taunted enemy can't decline to feed **Brace**.

blocks.subtitle: No button, no mana, no cooldown — each one fires on a moment in the fight.

skills.name: Momentum
skills.effect: Each basic attack you land grants **+1 Momentum**. Every stack adds **+3% to all your damage** and lasts **5s** on its own timer, so they expire one at a time — your standing count settles at however fast you swing. Deathblow spends the whole pile.

skills.name: Flow
skills.effect: Staying on one target pays: every basic attack grants **extra Momentum equal to a third of your unbroken run of hits** on that body. Switching targets, or a hit that deals nothing, ends the run and starts it over.

skills.name: Encore
skills.effect: A kill during **Blade Dance** grants **7 more dance charges**, extending the storm. Only fires while Blade Dance is running — and it doesn't add Parry charges, so a long dance outlives its guard.

skills.name: Opening
skills.effect: A successful **Parry** has a **50% chance** to open them up: your next attack deals **+200% damage** within **5s**. One attack spends it — **hit or miss** — and the bonus lands before their armor, so it is worth more the tankier they are.

skills.name: Unwavering
skills.effect: Casting **Guard Stance** makes you immune to **knockback and stagger** for **6s** — exactly as long as the stance itself. Pairs with Committed Strike's long wind-up.

skills.name: Lock Blades
skills.effect: Casting **Lunge** arms **5 charges**, each lasting **5s** and granting **+5% Attack Speed** while held (**+25%** at five). Each hit you land spends one to **automatically lunge** at the target again, so it can't disengage while you keep connecting. Auto-lunges don't spend charges of their own. With none left, nothing fires.

skills.name: Last Stand
skills.effect: Dropping to low health arms **5 more Brace charges**. The moment you are nearly dead is the moment you can hold back more hits — and every hit you hold makes the **Retribution** release bigger.

skills.name: Composure
skills.flavor: A read pays for the next one.
skills.effect: After a successful **Parry**, mana returns at **2 per second for 4s** — about **8 MP**, roughly one reaction skill.

skills.name: Pressure
skills.effect: Hits on the same target **delay its health regeneration**.

items: **Deathblow** — swing to build Momentum, keep **Flow** running by staying on one target, then cash it all in one blow. Overclock stacks it faster at the cost of a fragile window.

**Retribution** — Brace to bank the hits you were going to take, then release. **Challenge** stops them walking away from the bank; **Last Stand** hands you more charges exactly when you're about to die. Overclock's doubled incoming damage doubles the bank, turning its drawback into the payoff.

**Blade Dance** — Overclock first: attack speed buys more dance charges, more parries and a faster beat. **Encore** keeps it going on every kill. The doubled damage taken is real — the Parry charges are your only cover.
